system.description: CAPPED to out-of-conflict recovery. Printed: recover 5 HP per turn while in heavy shadows or darkness, or every few minutes outside a conflict. In most settings that condition is a real one; here it is the default lighting — London fog, gaslight, night work, cellars, the Underground works, and a doctrine that Rippers fight out of public view. Uncapped it is a mastery heroic granting permanent regeneration. Capped, the vampire is simply the one who is fine after a bad night. (The alternative cap is once per scene; either works.)
